description: Creates an exercise instance with duration/reps, pace, weight, RPE. Use when building a workout manually - create instances for each exercise, then pass instance IDs to create_workout. Stock and team exercises can be used directly via exercise_id.

amrap.description: true = as many reps as possible in the time. Timed steps only.

duration_seconds.description: Timed steps: work time in seconds, e.g. 30.

exercise_id.description: Exercise ID from list_team_exercises (team or stock exercise).

reps.description: Rep-based steps: number of reps, e.g. 12.

rpe.description: Target effort (RPE), 0 to 10. 0 or omitted = no target.

skip_intro.description: true skips the exercise intro before this step.

team_id.description: Not used: this tool works on the signed-in team. Leave it out.

time_based.description: true = timed step (needs duration_seconds); false = rep-based step (needs reps).

name: create_exercise_instance
title: Create exercise instance
